en.title: Mokpo for the Food: 2 Days, 1 Night
en.summary: This is the course YouTuber choichoi ate their way through over 2 days and 1 night in Mokpo. Starting with jjolboktang (small pufferfish soup), it links Mokpo's signature foods, from hongeo samhap (fermented skate with pork and kimchi), minaeo hoe (raw croaker) and haejangguk (hangover soup) to baekban (Korean set meal), with ocean-view and back-alley cafés. We analyzed the video frames and arranged the stops in the order they actually appear.
